profile.name: Arbin电池循环测试仪
profile.description: 用于电池与电芯充放电循环测试的多通道测试设备。它通常用于记录各通道运行状态和测量读数，支持实验室中的容量评估、循环寿命测试和电池性能表征。
profile.description_en: A multi-channel battery test instrument used for charge-discharge cycling of batteries and cells. It is typically used to track channel status and measurement readings for laboratory capacity evaluation, cycle life testing, and battery performance characterization.
